name: parties.reactivate-party
description: Reactivate an existing inactive party. Processing must be unrestricted and the current erasure status must be Active. An already active party is unchanged only after these checks.

PartyId.description: The supplied PartyId, at most 128 characters, shared by the root and every child operation; tenant comes from the gateway envelope. For new IDs use ASCII letters or digits plus '.', '_' or '-'; start and end with an ASCII letter or digit. Parties accepts legacy braced, parenthesized and X-format GUID IDs, but their McpCli/Gateway reachability remains unproven.
